answer: Volkswagen reported 883.74 MtCO2e total Scope 3 emissions and 752.57 MtCO2e for Category 11 use of sold products in 2025. It reports all 15 GHG Protocol/ESRS categories and includes Chinese joint ventures, with category calculations split between Group and business-area levels. MAN light commercial vehicles are included in both Passenger Cars and Commercial Vehicles, creating acknowledged double counting to be removed next year. Selected qualifications include Category 9 being included in Category 4, Passenger Cars/LCV Category 10 being included in Scope 1, some Power Engineering categories being not material, and supply-chain estimates relying primarily on secondary industry-average data while bills of materials provide vehicle primary data.
